feature: Interactive same-pool rainfall and parent-copy contribution lens in captured weather futures
changes: The existing weather chart now switches between Traits through time and Rainfall & parent chances. Selecting a lens or parent pauses recorded playback without generating new organisms.

Potential parents appear by actual inherited trait and exact expected share of newborn copies. Filled recorded-rainfall points and outlined same-pool steady-rainfall points share one zero-based, explicitly labelled adaptive axis.
Native parent selection, keyboard-operable SVG groups, previous-island provenance and recorded inherited-copy counts connect relative reproductive contributions to actual individuals.

Three stages distinguish conditional rainfall weighting, realized parent/allele sampling, and copied-trait mutation. Expectations use the exact lottery of two distinct parents; they are not survival probabilities.

The selected private branch, generation and island supply the actual post-dispersal parent and opposing-species pools. Only local rainfall is substituted with the captured steady baseline; rainfall-dependent plant cost is recalculated.

Captured starting organisms expose no future breeding evidence even when the original source already has a recorded history. Selection-off and unchanged-rainfall calculations expose exact zero contrasts; missing breeding contexts remain undefined.

Selected parents and explanations use a hash of the complete canonical weather recipe plus condition, generation, island and species. The latest24 draft views persist locally; a different schedule sharing the source and batch cannot inherit an old explanation.

The existing weather journal and JSON export include mechanism context, explanation, exact values and a reconstruction protocol using the authoritative climate recipe. Saved evidence is not replayed as authoritative outcomes.

The repeated weather collection Inspect this weather pair bridge retains the active lens and opens actual parent evidence for that batch. Phone layouts retain44px native controls and contained scrolling tables.

scientificLimits: Conditional rainfall weighting on an actual recorded pool is not a full decomposition of differences between evolving weather futures
Actual partner distributions are held fixed, not approximated by their mean
Habitat weighting and plant trait cost depend on the substituted rainfall; model coefficients and other settings stay fixed
Expected shares measure relative copied-trait contribution with two distinct parents, not survival probability
Finite parent/allele sampling and copied-trait mutation can differ from expected inheritance
No organism changes genes to meet a need; moving means alone do not prove adaptation or reciprocal coevolution
Private offspring IDs belong to one branch and round
The fictional model is not a real climate/ecosystem forecast
